adaptations: Debugfs display tail and logging omitted; full station policy and chip tables retained.
One serialized station; delayed Linux work uses caller-driven monotonic deadlines.
BT MP requests are asynchronous to avoid blocking USB completion on the same controller gate.
Firmware commands share the typed AU bootstrap H2C cursor.
Inactive BT threshold counter saturates at10 instead of wrapping after256 checks.
SCAN_FINISH preserves the actual caller scan-cache count instead of the upstream TODO30.

Busy MP slots retain one latest desired LNA level; real C2H completion or a bounded periodic timeout retries it after live authority checks. The applied level is cached only after successful H2C/scoreboard admission; stop/error/reset discards deferred work.
